path.id: Preserve distinctive poses and vein / branch rhythms; simplify dense decoration. Counts and symmetry are design decisions. These motifs are shared rural imagery, not exclusive regional identifiers.
Supplied images, in upload order. Titles, artists and regional attribution remain unverified. Images 02 and 03 provide comparative context. Each extracted icon stays traceable to one visible detail.
Shanghai Municipal Government and Shanghai tourism: bold colour, full compositions and local folk techniques. This context does not establish authorship of the supplied works.
